en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hilltop castle complex dominating a small European town. Large multi‑storey stone buildings with steep gabled roofs and small towers are enclosed by defensive walls above a slope with trees and terraced gardens. In the foreground are clustered houses with pitched roofs, and to the left stands a church with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome. The scene looks rural with open fields and low hills in the distance. There is no visible postcard text or caption on the image side.
